Norwegian broadcaster NRK said several Bodø/Glimt supporters fell through with four receiving medical attention and one of them hospitalized. "We have had a serious incident in the away section during the match," Tromsø said in a statement. "Preliminary information indicates that a person has fallen through the stands and sustained injuries." NRK reported that the incident occurred in the 41st minute of the game. It was raining heavily at the time.

stories.title: Can any player refuse to be traded in IPL? Explaining BCCI's consent forms and rules for denying a trade
stories.summary: Here's a look at BCCI's consent forms and rules for denying a trade and if a player can refuse to be traded to another team. No player in the Indian Premier League (IPL) can be traded without signing a BCCI consent form, and signing is entirely their choice. Trade talks between franchises cannot legally begin until that signed form reaches the BCCI. A player who consents cannot then pick his destination, as the selling franchise chooses the bid. Yes. The consent form sits at the centre of every IPL trade, and a player who declines to sign it cannot be moved, regardless of what the two franchises have agreed between themselves.

Saints great Cameron Jordan about to hit an impressive NFL milestone
stories.summary: When New Orleans defensive end Cameron Jordan takes the field against the Cleveland Browns, he'll join rare company in NFL history. When Jordan takes the field for regular season game number 250 today, he'll achieve a rare milestone. He'll become just the third defensive player to play in 250 or more games in NFL history with the same team. Cornerback Darrell Green played 295 games with the Washington Redskins over a 20-year stretch between 1983 and 2002. Defensive end Jim Marshall suited up in 282 contests for the Minnesota Vikings between 1960 and 1979, a span of 20 seasons. Green is a member of the Pro Football Hall of Fame, while Marshall was a semifinalist in 2023 and 2024.

When warming ocean waters bleach the vibrant colors of coral to white, that’s one example. “Many young scientists who are working on coral reefs don’t realize that what they’re seeing is vastly degraded,” says Anya Salih, a scientist who has studied coral reefs and their fluorescent colors for decades. “It’s often hard to perceive how it was to what it is now.”
